all_tools.example_call: get_vm_metrics(subscription_id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', resource_group='your-resource-group', vm_name='your-vm-name', metric_names='Percentage CPU,Available Memory,Network In,Network Out,Disk Read Operations/Sec,Disk Write Operations/Sec', timespan='PT1H')
all_tools.name: get_vm_metrics

params.metric_names: string (required) - Comma-separated list of metric names (e.g. Percentage CPU,Available Memory,Network In,Network Out,Disk Read Operations/Sec,Disk Write Operations/Sec)
params.timespan: string (optional) - Time span for the metrics (e.g. PT1H for 1 hour)

sample_args.metric_names: Percentage CPU,Available Memory,Network In,Network Out,Disk Read Operations/Sec,Disk Write Operations/Sec

all_tools.description: List OS disk and attached managed data disks with sizes, caching, and LUNs
all_tools.name: list_vm_disks

all_tools.description: Attach a managed data disk to the VM
all_tools.example_call: attach_data_disk(subscription_id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', resource_group='your-resource-group', vm_name='your-vm-name', disk_name='your-disk-name', lun=0, caching='ReadWrite', size_gb=100)
all_tools.name: attach_data_disk

params.caching: string (optional) - Caching type (e.g. None, ReadOnly, ReadWrite)
params.disk_name: string (required) - Name of the managed data disk
params.lun: integer (required) - Logical Unit Number (LUN) for the disk
params.size_gb: integer (optional) - Size of the disk in GB

params.disk_name: string (optional) - Name of the managed data disk
params.lun: integer (optional) - Logical Unit Number (LUN) for the disk
